title: Banana oat pancakes
summary: Soft, naturally sweet pancakes for bananas at their best.
why_it_fits: Ripe banana gives the batter sweetness and keeps the pancakes tender.
steps: Blend or mash the bananas, eggs, oats, cinnamon, and salt.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes.
Cook small pancakes in a lightly oiled skillet until golden on both sides.

title: One-bowl banana bread
summary: A forgiving loaf that turns very ripe bananas into something warm and sliceable.
why_it_fits: Very ripe bananas bring concentrated sweetness and moisture to the loaf.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a loaf pan.
Mash bananas with butter, sugar, and egg.
Fold in flour, baking soda, and salt.
Bake until the center is set and a tester comes out with a few moist crumbs.

title: Crisp green banana fritters
summary: A savory, crisp preparation for firm green bananas.
why_it_fits: Firm green bananas hold their shape and work well with a savory coating.
steps: Peel and slice the green bananas lengthwise.
Mix flour, paprika, and salt.
Coat the slices and pan-fry until crisp and golden.

title: Quick apple compote
summary: A soft, cinnamon-scented spoonful for toast, oats, or yogurt.
why_it_fits: Cooking brings out sweetness even when the apples are past their crispest peak.
steps: Dice the apples.
Simmer apples, water, lemon juice, and cinnamon until tender.
Mash lightly and serve warm or chilled.

title: Bright apple slaw
summary: A crunchy, sharp side that makes fresh use of a firm apple.
why_it_fits: Crisp apple adds lift and texture to cabbage and herbs.
steps: Slice the apples into matchsticks.
Toss with cabbage, lemon juice, olive oil, and herbs.
Season and serve immediately.

title: Orange vinaigrette
summary: A bright dressing for greens, grains, or roasted vegetables.
why_it_fits: Juicy orange supplies acidity and sweetness in one step.
steps: Whisk orange juice, zest, vinegar, and mustard.
Stream in olive oil while whisking.
Season and shake before serving.

title: Fast orange peel simmer
summary: A small-batch citrus topping for toast or yogurt.
why_it_fits: A gentle simmer gives softer oranges a second use with sugar and spice.
steps: Slice oranges thinly and remove seeds.
Simmer with sugar, water, and cinnamon until glossy.
Cool before spooning over toast or yogurt.

title: Strawberry yogurt bowl
summary: A five-minute breakfast that keeps the berries front and center.
why_it_fits: Ripe strawberries bring color and brightness without much preparation.
steps: Slice the strawberries.
Spoon yogurt into bowls.
Top with berries, granola, and honey.

title: Small-batch strawberry jam
summary: A quick stovetop preserve for berries that need using soon.
why_it_fits: Soft berries break down quickly into a spoonable topping.
steps: Hull and crush the strawberries.
Simmer with sugar and lemon juice until thickened.
Cool and refrigerate in a clean jar.

title: Lemony avocado toast
summary: A simple savory use for a soft, spreadable avocado.
why_it_fits: Ripe avocado mashes smoothly and carries lemon, chili, and herbs.
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Spread over toast and finish with chili flakes.

title: Avocado lime salsa
summary: A cool, chunky topping for tacos, beans, or grilled vegetables.
why_it_fits: The recipe works when the avocado is ready to cube but does not need to be perfectly smooth.
steps: Dice avocado, tomato, and onion.
Toss with lime juice and cilantro.
Season gently and serve immediately.

title: Avocado cocoa mousse
summary: A smooth chocolate-style dessert for a soft avocado.
why_it_fits: A very soft avocado blends into a creamy base with cocoa and maple.
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Taste and adjust sweetness.
Chill for 20 minutes before serving.
